# Edgar Duc

PhD student at Université Côte d'Azur and Julius-Maximilians-Universität Würzburg working on **theoretical guarantees for LLM alignment** under the supervision of [Samuel Vaiter](https://samuelvaiter.com) and [Damien Garreau](https://sites.google.com/view/damien-garreau/home).
Feel free to contact me if you want to chat about science, or if you have internship opportunities.
